scenarios.name: Collapse and reopens the part origin branch during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited
the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch and other document entries
the user selects the expansion control beside Origin
the Origin branch collapses and its child entries are hidden
the other document entries remain visible in the browser
the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
the user selects the expansion control beside Origin again
the Origin branch expands and its child entries are displayed
the other document entries remain visible
the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
